definitions.name: Haunted by the Shadows
definitions.summary: Table homebrew. +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Invisibility and Cause Fear once each per long rest without a slot, using the chosen ability. Vengeance: advantage on attacks against non-lawful evil creatures that haven't acted yet this combat. Curse: after killing a non-evil creature that isn't undead or a construct, -5 to attacks, checks and saves for 1d6 rounds; only a celestial of CR 10+ can lift it.

when.text: target is non-lawful, evil, and hasn't taken a turn in this combat yet

actions.name: Invisibility (free)
actions.note: Once per long rest without a slot.

actions.name: Cause Fear (free)
actions.note: Once per long rest without a slot.

definitions.name: Actor
definitions.summary: +1 Charisma. Advantage on Deception and Performance checks to pass as someone else. Mimic voices and sounds (Insight vs. your Deception to spot it). Disguise kit proficiency, or expertise if already proficient.

when.text: passing yourself off as a different person
passing yourself off as a different person

definitions.name: Athlete
definitions.summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Athletics proficiency, or expertise if already proficient. Standing up costs 5 ft, climbing costs no extra movement, running jumps after 5 ft, and add proficiency bonus to jump distance.

definitions.name: Charger
definitions.summary: Dash as a bonus action. Once per round, after Dashing and moving 10+ ft straight at a target: +5 + proficiency bonus to a melee hit's damage, or push 10 ft with a shove (target at most two sizes larger; two sizes larger has advantage to resist).

when.text: after Dash and 10 ft straight-line move; once per round

definitions.name: Defensive Duelist
definitions.summary: Reaction when hit in melee while wielding a proficient finesse weapon: +proficiency bonus + half Dexterity modifier (rounded up, minimum 1) to AC against that attack; full Dexterity modifier if you took the Dodge action.

definitions.name: Dual Wielder
definitions.summary: +2 AC while wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand. Two-weapon fighting with non-light one-handed melee weapons. Draw or stow two one-handed weapons at once. Add proficiency bonus to the off-hand attack's damage; with the Two-Weapon Fighting style, use either bonus, not both.

definitions.name: Dungeon Delver
definitions.summary: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to find secret doors, traps and hazards, and on saves against traps and hazards. Resistance to trap damage. Fast pace doesn't lower passive Perception.

when.text: to find secret doors, traps and hazards
to find secret doors, traps and hazards

definitions.name: Durable
definitions.summary: +1 Constitution. Hit Dice heal at least twice your Constitution modifier (minimum 2). Reaction when damaged: spend a Hit Die to reduce the damage by the die + Constitution modifier (minimum 3), before resistances. Regain all Hit Dice on a long rest.

definitions.name: Elemental Adept
definitions.summary: Requires spellcasting. Pick acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder: your spells ignore resistance to it, and its damage dice roll at least your proficiency bonus. Can be taken again for another type.

definitions.name: Grappler
definitions.summary: Requires Strength 13. Advantage on attacks against a creature you grapple. Action: pin a grappled creature (both restrained). While pinning a non-undead, non-construct: action to injure it (Con save vs. 8 + proficiency + Strength); on a failure it must pass a DC 10 Con save each time it acts in combat or lose the action and reactions. Heals with magical healing or ten days of rest.

when.text: against a creature you are grappling

definitions.name: Healer
definitions.summary: Stabilizing with a healer's kit also restores 1 + proficiency bonus HP. Action: spend a kit use to restore 1d12 + 4 + the creature's maximum Hit Dice in HP, once per short or long rest per creature.

definitions.name: Heavily Armored
definitions.summary: Requires medium armor proficiency. +1 Strength; proficiency with heavy armor and shields.

definitions.name: Keen Mind
definitions.summary: +1 Intelligence. Always know north and the hours until sunrise or sunset; perfect recall of the past month. Investigation and Survival proficiency, or expertise in each one already known.

definitions.name: Linguist
definitions.summary: +1 Intelligence, four languages, and ciphers others can't read without a check (DC Intelligence score + proficiency bonus). DC 15 Intelligence check to get the gist of an unknown language, repeatable each hour.

definitions.name: Mage Slayer
definitions.summary: Reaction: melee attack a creature within 5 ft that casts a spell. Creatures you damage have disadvantage on concentration saves, and take 2 + proficiency bonus psychic damage if they lose it. Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects from creatures within 15 ft.

when.text: against a spell or magical effect from a creature within 15 ft

definitions.name: Medium Armor Master
definitions.summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Medium armor doesn't hurt Stealth, and allows up to +3 Dexterity to AC with Dexterity 16 or higher.

definitions.name: Polearm Master
definitions.summary: +1 Strength. With a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff or spear: bonus-action butt-end attack (d4 bludgeoning, same ability). With those or a pike, creatures entering your reach provoke opportunity attacks.

definitions.name: Ritual Caster
definitions.summary: Requires Intelligence or Wisdom 13. A ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from one class list, using that class's ability. Copy more ritual spells found (2 hours and 50 gp per level, up to half your level rounded up); two free ones at each Ability Score Improvement level.

definitions.name: Savage Attacker
definitions.summary: Once per turn on melee weapon damage, replace the weapon dice with 1d12, 2d6 or 3d4; if it already uses one of those, add proficiency bonus instead. Uses: 3 + proficiency bonus per long rest. On a critical hit you may add your Strength or Dexterity modifier twice.

actions.name: Savage Attacker
actions.note: Once per turn on melee weapon damage: replace the weapon dice with 1d12, 2d6 or 3d4.

definitions.name: Shield Master
definitions.summary: While wielding a shield: shove as part of the Attack action; add the shield's AC bonus to Strength and Dexterity saves against spells and harmful effects; reaction to take no damage on a successful half-damage save.

when.text: against a spell or harmful effect
against a spell or harmful effect

definitions.name: Skilled
definitions.summary: Proficiency in any four skills or tools. Skills are picked here; tools taken instead are entered as manual proficiencies.

definitions.name: Spell Sniper
definitions.summary: Attack-roll spells have double range and ignore half and three-quarters cover. Two attack cantrips from one class list (that class's ability). Once per short or long rest, bonus action if you haven't moved: advantage on your next spell attack this turn; speed becomes 0.

definitions.name: Tavern Brawler
definitions.summary: +1 Strength or Constitution. Proficient with improvised weapons (d6 damage); unarmed strikes deal d4. On a hit with either, attempt a grapple as part of the attack.
